description.zh: 实例名称（精确过滤，逗号分隔多个）
description.en: The instance name. This parameter is used for exact match filtering. Separate multiple instance names with commas (,).
The instance description. This parameter supports fuzzy match.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。默认值：当不设置值或设置的值小于10时，默认值为10。当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: If you do not specify this parameter or specify a value less than 10, the default value is 10. If you specify a value greater than 100, the default value is 100.
The token for the next query.
The page number. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

title.zh: 查询 Supabase 实例列表

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于获取用户已配置的自定义终端节点（Endpoint）列表，便于管理和查看私有连接或VPC终端服务的设置。
descriptions.en: Queries the list of custom endpoints configured by the user for managing and viewing private connection or VPC endpoint service settings.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx describe-supabase-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --db-instance-name pxsp-hz00000000 --description project_name --max-results 1000 --next-token xxdds --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx DescribeSupabaseInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Description project_name --PageSize 30 --NextToken xxdds --PageNumber 1 --MaxResults 1000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceName 'pxsp-hz00000000'
